thread:
ashley: starting canary for release v0.9.12 -> eu-west (canary 20%). change window 10:00-11:00 UTC. pls watch embed-route p95 and 5xx. deploy-bot will post checkpoints.

deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v0.9.12 -> eu-west (canary 20%). checks queued: smoke, obs, canary-health. status: in-progress https://console.redwood.io/rollouts/1719997777
kai: quick note, dashboards are showing a tail spike on /embed p95 ~1m after start, delta +160ms. no wide 5xx spike yet.
ops-bot: hostpool event: hostpool-embed-eu-2 GC pause at 09:58:10 UTC (duration ~4.8s). correlated with latency bump.

tracy: ran initial smoke tests: auth/basic ok. heavy payloads (>6k tokens) 50-sample -> 6 timeouts (504) hitting canary slice. small sample but non-trivial.

ashley: don't advance ramp. keep at 20%. raj, can we route heavy payloads to previous stable (v0.9.11-quant) for canary only? that's less risky than rollback.

raj: route policy shows fallback available. I can apply route override for only requests with header X-Req-Size:heavy in canary. command: `redwood route override apply --route "/embed" --env eu-west --match "header:X-Req-Size=heavy" --to embed-v0.9.11-quant --scope canary --ttl 10m`

lisa_monitor: injecting query: across canary slice, heavy requests 5m rates: 280 total, pre-override 6x504s (~2.1%), pre-override p95 +150-220ms.

raj: applying override now. will post id.

deploy-bot: override applied (ro-1719997777-A). heavy payloads in canary routed to embed-v0.9.11-quant for 10m. auto-expire enabled.

tracy: re-running heavy payload smoke: 60 requests -> 0 timeouts, p95 ~135ms. improvement visible.

kai: dashboard: overall canary /embed p95 back to +40ms, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in canary. hostpool-embed-eu-2 GC still shows elevated pause p90 but requests hitting stable variant now.

ashley: plan: monitor for the 10m TTL. if stable, proceed slow ramp to 50% after check-in. if 5xx > 1% or p95 > +150ms for 5m, full rollback to v0.9.11 cluster-wide. also open ENG-PLAT-5637 for kernel/quant-compat investigation.

lisa_monitor: checkpoint @+5m: canary total 2.4k reqs, heavy 310 samples, 504s before=6 after=0, p95 delta baseline -> +35ms.

raj: note: route override configured as canary-only so rollout remains isolated. will leave monitoring alert on for sudden regrowth.

ops-bot: scheduled a GC jitter on hostpool-embed-eu to avoid aligned pauses in next maintenance window (ops ticket OPS-9821).

ashley: thanks. I'll draft a short release note amendment: "deferred heavy-payload model variant due to hostpool GC interaction; guarding canary with route override, further investigation ongoing."

tracy: thumbs up. keeping thread pinned to the change window.

deploy-bot: checkpoint: 10m elapsed, override expired automatically, canary remains healthy, recommended: slow ramp to 50% on manual approval.

ashley: approved to ramp to 50% now. tagging eng-sre for overnight watch. :eyes:
